data.business: The Group is engaged in manufacturing, selling, and distributing paints, coatings, home décor products, bath fittings, modular kitchens, decorative lighting, uPVC doors and windows, and providing related services [0.30]. Sales to dealers or distributors represent 99.0% of total sales in FY 2025-26 [0.21]. Additionally, the company operates a home painting service called Beautiful Homes Painting Service and engages with over 137,000 business influencers [0.3, 1.3].
data.narrative: Both the annual report and management concalls reflect a shared emphasis on expanding manufacturing capabilities, home decor services, and retail presence [0.8, 0.9, 1.3, 1.4, 2.2, 3.6]. Management calls focus more directly on short-term operational execution, such as driving high single-digit volume growth, scaling new product contributions to 16-17% of revenue, and adding retail touchpoints [1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 3.2, 3.3, 3.4]. The emphasis on calls also shifts toward managing margin volatility through price increases to offset input cost inflation and addressing seasonal factors like monsoons [1.10, 1.17, 2.4, 2.12, 4.13], whereas the annual report concentrates on governance, long-term investments, and risk management frameworks [0.8, 0.10, 0.17, 0.37].

bull.point: New products launched within a three-year period consistently contribute between 16% and 17% of overall company revenues [1.2, 1.9, 2.1, 3.3].
The company continues expanding its distribution network by adding thousands of retail touchpoints and scaling its Beautiful Home stores network [1.4, 2.2, 3.4, 3.6].
Gross margins reached an all-time high of 45.6% in Q4, backed by a strong group liquidity position of Rs 9,762.11 crores [0.34, 2.4].
Manufacturing capacity and backward integration projects are expanding in India and abroad, including a new plant in Madhya Pradesh and a VAM-VAE project [0.8, 0.9, 2.13, 2.16].

bear.point: Input cost increases of nearly 25% significantly outpaced cumulative price increases of 9% to 11% [1.17, 2.12].
The company registered an exceptional impairment charge close to Rs 94 crores for White Teak [3.14].
Asian Paints faces legal exposure from ongoing proceedings before the Competition Commission of India and an appellate forum [0.13].
Adverse weather conditions such as an extended monsoon and product mix variations impact quarterly performance and margins [1.19, 4.13].

data.balance: As of 31st March 2026, the company reported long-term borrowings of Rs 805.42 crores, with Rs 771.43 crores hypothecated as security for borrowings [0.6, 0.32]. Standalone cash, bank balances, and investments reached Rs 9,014.60 crores, bringing total group liquidity to Rs 9,762.11 crores [0.7, 0.31, 0.34].
